question: How does the number of arms relate to the qualities beginning with sattva?
premises: The tamasic form is described as eight-armed.
This is stated in relation to the sequence beginning with sattvic.
inference: The forms corresponding to qualities beginning with sattva include an eight-armed tamasic aspect.
uncertainties: The arm counts for sattvic and rajasic forms are not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The tamasic form is eight-armed; thus it is described beginning with the sattvic and so on.
